# Change

Describe the problem, resulting behaviour, and affected machines or documentation.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish metadata checks, full image
builds, and hardware tests, and state any checks not run.

## Contribution requirements

- [ ] Commits include Signed-off-by trailers.
- [ ] BSP changes use machine overrides and follow the contributor guide.
- [ ] Documentation sources and generated site are updated together when affected.
- [ ] Relevant issue or upstream references are linked.
